chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Gelsenkirchen, 2024. England are losing to Slovakia. Ninety-fifth minute. Walker's long throw. Guéhi flicks it on. Bellingham... overhead kick! One-one!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Slow motion. Back to goal, Jude jumps and gets his body under the ball. His leg swings up and across, over his head.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: The keeper is beaten. Thirty seconds from going home, and England are still alive!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Beginners: only practise on soft mats, with a coach. Get under the ball, swing your leg across it, land on your hands and back. And never, ever give up!
